about_the_game:
Game Introduction

When one day becomes eternal, how can we escape from such a cage?

A tale that belongs only to them in the endless cycle!

The girls search for a distant tomorrow in the ruins of their memories.

What secrets are hidden in the perpetually recurring July 1st?

Linear narrative! Layered and progressive endings! No need to worry about missing content due to choices! No matter what you choose, you can fully experience all the content!

Unexpected plot twists! It seems that everything is not quite as you imagined?

As the story progresses step by step, you will be a part of it and personally uncover the ultimate mystery.

Try before you buy! No loss! A full trial version with a complete ending is available for you to experience!

Hope you can find the summer treasures and something born from the daily flames together with them during your journey.

Character Introduction

Wei

She did not reveal her real name to the players, so the surname is unknown. She simply calls herself "Wei".

One of the main victims of the daily cycle world, and the only human in the entire world who can still be called active. Before the cycle began, he was a student at a nearby middle school. But due to bullying and mental illness, he had been on a long-term suspension from school at home for over a year. He was supposed to wait at home for his condition to improve before starting a new campus life. But after the cycle began, he would wake up every day in his dim bedroom. At first, he was afraid and uneasy about the cycle. But after learning that no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't change his situation, before meeting Al Wright, he was just someone who would stay in his room and give up on himself.

Arle.Light

A girl who claims to be an alien but has a human appearance. She also boasts that she has a spaceship that can traverse the galaxy, but the crashed spaceship and the malfunctioning landing pod that was trapped that day have vanished without a trace. It's hard not to suspect that she is just a pitiful child with a delusion. However, the only thing that convinces people is that her condition seems to be even more severe. She wakes up in the park every day, but because the daily cycle of the world is always rainy, she is always wet. She has to brave the rain to go to her home to get some rest.

Game size/Scale

100,000 - 150,000 words, 20 illustrations without differentiation, over 40 different expressions for each character. And throughout, there are exquisite and concise performance effects. Finally, there is complete dubbing for the two main characters.

Additional Information

This project is still in the process of intense preparation. The above information may be subject to modification. The production team will update with a complete introduction as soon as possible!

  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: anything
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: anything
  • VR Support: no support

Recommended:
  • OS: windows11 x64
  • Processor: i7
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: anything

short_description: GreySky&StarNavigator is a text-based adventure game. In the game, you will learn about the story of a young girl trapped in a one-day world. You will follow her perspective to experience the joyous daily life of her alien companions, and eventually find a way to escape from this world.
